שכונת התקווה היא אחת השכונות המיוחדות וה: The Hatikva neighborhood is one of the most special and important neighborhoods in Israel. In a world that grows ever more synthetic, "Hatikva" is a distilled capsule of authentic, living reality. It is hard to think of another neighborhood in the country that holds such a unique blend of center and periphery, old and new, East and West.

בדצמבר 2022 נפגשו גיא זוזות, מנהל בית דנ: In December 2022, Guy Zuzut, director of Beit Dani, met artist Amir Chodorov. The meeting gave rise to "Walls That Tell" in the roller-skating hall at Beit Dani, the first of which is the right-hand wall. Like all the project's walls, it is built from thousands of photographs and documents joined into a single image.
מאולם הגלגיליות הפרויקט צמח לכ־1,200 מ״ר: From the roller-skating hall the project grew to some 1,200 m² of walls and artworks: at Beit Dani, at the Bnei Yehuda club, in the synagogues, in the market and in the neighborhood's streets.
